upstreamReadOnlyReview.summary: Design engineering, deliberate component feedback, purposeful motion and good defaults; project-specific layout choices are an application of user feedback.

projectApplication: Scene and immediate actions take visual priority
Reduce persistent explanatory/engineering text; details remain available on demand
Clear typography/spacing/selection and usable component defaults
Panels support useful resize/collapse behavior without obscuring essential controls
Fast feedback; restrained purposeful motion; high-frequency input stays immediate
Fix first-person usability before lower-priority layout polish
